description: GRIDDED MAP in 4 panels (concat, 2 columns, one shared colour scale). Each square is a 0.5 degree grid cell (about 50 km) coloured by April-October rainfall as % of its 1991-2022 average. Data: data/rain_grid.json from SILO monthly rainfall; fields s0-s3 hold the four seasons. Squares are 'square' marks placed by longitude and latitude. A thin outline of the farming regions is drawn on top, then a short note per panel and the 8 capital cities (city_layers).

title.subtitle: Wet in the east, dry in the west

text: less than half their usual rain
